note: What a commander learns in the field and what it buys (commanders.md section 6). Casualties inflicted and nothing else, because battles.md section 6 has no rout and no surrender so winning is not a quantity that exists. Every figure here is a tuning target section 9 names - casualties per level, how many levels there are, and what each bonus is worth - and none of them is measured. A bonus names a knob in CommanderExperience.READ_BY; a knob nothing reads is refused by the validator. rank is an id and never a sentence: the words live in data/ranks_en so a second language is a copied folder, and a letter keys its line off the id rather than rendering a number the PC is not meant to see.
